lines: +    // Treat a closed receiver as success because that should only happen at shutdown.

positive.scope: Refactor the worker dispatch path. The receiver can close when a worker is replaced while jobs are still queued. Failed dispatch must stay observable so the queue can retry.
positive.rationale: The comment dismisses a normal lifecycle failure and would misreport queued work.

control.scope: Adjust logging in the shutdown-only dispatch path. This helper is called only after jobs have been handed off to the durable queue and workers have stopped. A closed receiver is an expected successful outcome there.
control.rationale: The task establishes shutdown as the caller invariant and specifies the observed result.
